fields.Name: Inactive
fields.doc: State used when an addon restriction is not being enforced.

fields.Name: Activating
fields.doc: State used during the dispatch of ADDON_RESTRICTION_STATE_CHANGED to infer that a restriction is about to become active, but won't be enforced until event dispatch has completed.

fields.Name: Active
fields.doc: State used when an addon restriction is presently being enforced.

fields.Name: Combat
fields.doc: The player is actively affecting combat.

fields.Name: Encounter
fields.doc: The player is actively participating in an instance encounter.

fields.Name: ChallengeMode
fields.doc: The player is in an active and incomplete challenge mode or mythic keystone dungeon.

fields.Name: PvPMatch
fields.doc: The player is in an active and incomplete PvP match.

fields.Name: Map
fields.doc: The player is on a map that applies addon restrictions.

fields.Name: Chat
fields.doc: The player is in a state where addon chat communications are restricted.

fields.Name: Standard
fields.doc: Encodes with the alphabet defined in RFC 4648 (with potential padding bytes)

fields.Name: StandardUrlSafe
fields.doc: Encodes with the 'URL and Filename Safe' alphabet from RFC 4648 (with potential padding bytes)

fields.Name: Character
fields.doc: Locate extended grapheme cluster boundaries, which are treated as user-perceived character units.

fields.Name: Word
fields.doc: Locate word boundaries for selection, search, and whole-word operations, including locale dictionary support where available.

fields.Name: Sentence
fields.doc: Locate sentence boundaries while handling cases such as periods in numbers or abbreviations and trailing punctuation.

fields.Name: Line
fields.doc: Locate positions where text can wrap, using Unicode line-breaking rules that handle punctuation and hyphenated words.

fields.Name: Primary
fields.doc: Compare base-character differences and ignore accents, case, and later collation levels.

fields.Name: Secondary
fields.doc: Compare accent or diacritic differences after base characters match, while ignoring tertiary differences such as case.

fields.Name: Tertiary
fields.doc: Compare case, letter variants, and similar tertiary differences after primary and secondary differences match.

fields.Name: Quaternary
fields.doc: Distinguish punctuation, whitespace, symbols, or Japanese Hiragana/Katakana differences after the first three levels match.

fields.Name: Identical
fields.doc: Use NFD Unicode code point order as a final tie-breaker after all other collation levels match.

fields.Name: Symbol
fields.doc: A symbolic name for a currency, such as '$' for USD.

fields.Name: NarrowSymbol
fields.doc: The shortest narrow currency symbol, such as '$' instead of 'US$' for USD in en-CA.

fields.Name: Long
fields.doc: The long name for a currency, such as 'US Dollar' for USD.

fields.Name: FormalSymbol
fields.doc: The formal currency symbol is similar to the regular currency symbol, but it always takes the form used in formal settings such as banking; for example, 'NT$' instead of '$' for TWD in zh-TW.

fields.Name: VariantSymbol
fields.doc: The variant symbol for a currency is an alternative symbol that is not necessarily as widely used as the regular symbol.

fields.Name: Stealable
fields.doc: Shows the dispel type only for stealable auras.

fields.Name: NotStealable
fields.doc: Shows the dispel type only for non-stealable auras.

fields.Name: Border
fields.doc: Uses a built-in border based on the aura's dispel type.

fields.Name: BorderWithIcon
fields.doc: Uses a built-in border with a corner icon based on the aura's dispel type.

fields.Name: Icon
fields.doc: Uses a built-in icon based on the aura's dispel type.

fields.Name: PreserveAsset
fields.doc: Preserves the texture's existing asset.

fields.Name: CustomAsset
fields.doc: Uses a custom texture asset selected from the configured dispel type asset map.

fields.Name: Assignment
fields.doc: Applies a newly assigned aura, resetting presentation state rather than transitioning from the previous aura.

fields.Name: Update
fields.doc: Refreshes the current aura assignment, allowing presentation state to retain continuity.

fields.Name: None
fields.doc: Do not include this date or time portion in the formatter.

fields.Name: Short
fields.doc: Use the shortest locale format, generally numeric, such as 12/13/52 or 3:30pm.

fields.Name: Medium
fields.doc: Use a longer locale format than Short, such as abbreviated month names for dates.

fields.Name: Long
fields.doc: Use a longer locale format with fuller names or time fields than Medium.

fields.Name: Full
fields.doc: Use the most completely specified locale format, such as weekday, era, or time zone when applicable.

fields.Name: RealTime
fields.doc: Use real time for duration calculations. Durations will speed up or slow down based on the applied mod time.

fields.Name: BaseTime
fields.doc: Use base time for duration calculations. Durations will be unaffected the applied mod time.

fields.Name: TextWarning
fields.doc: Color to be used when an encounter event shown as a text warning alert.

fields.Name: TimelineEvent
fields.doc: Color to be used when an encounter event is placed on the timeline.

fields.Name: TimelineEventHighlight
fields.doc: Color to be used when an encounter event reaches its 'highlight' duration on the timeline (typically, ~5s before the cast is due).

fields.Name: OnTextWarningShown
fields.doc: Trigger to be activated when an text warning is initially shown for an encounter event.

fields.Name: OnTimelineEventFinished
fields.doc: Trigger to be activated when an encounter event on the timeline transitions to a finished (ie. casted, or resolved) state.

fields.Name: OnTimelineEventHighlight
fields.doc: Trigger to be activated when an encounter event reaches its 'highlight' duration on the timeline (typically, ~5s before the cast is due).

fields.Name: ENCOUNTER_TIMELINE_INVALID_EVENT
fields.doc: Constant used for invalid event IDs. Script APIs are guaranteed to always return nil data if supplied this ID, and events will never be added to the timeline with this ID.

fields.Name: ENCOUNTER_TIMELINE_RESERVED_EVENT_COUNT
fields.doc: Minimum size of internal arrays that are preallocated for event storage.

fields.Name: Descending
fields.doc: Events are sorted in descending order (longest time remaining to shortest).

fields.Name: Ascending
fields.doc: Events are sorted in ascending order (shortest time remaining to longest).

EncounterTimelineEventSource.doc: Enumeration of all encounter timeline event sources.

fields.Name: Encounter
fields.doc: Source used for events added by an instance encounter.

fields.Name: Script
fields.doc: Source used for events added by Lua scripting APIs. This is used to apply API restrictions; the Pause/Cancel/ResumeScriptEvent functions only work on Script events.

fields.Name: EditMode
fields.doc: Source used for events added by the AddEditModeEvents script API.

EncounterTimelineEventState.doc: Enumeration of all encounter timeline event states.

EncounterTimelineTrack.doc: Enumeration of all encounter timeline tracks., Tracks are not permitted to overlap (but may have a zero duration span), and are contiguously ordered from shortest maximum duration to longest.

fields.Name: Short
fields.doc: This track always has a zero minimum duration.

fields.Name: Indeterminate
fields.doc: This track is used as a placeholder for events whose position is not calculated and shouldn't appear on the timeline.

EncounterTimelineTrackType.doc: Enumeration of all encounter timeline track types. Track types infer behavioral aspects of the track, for example whether or not we associate sort orders to events in the track.

EncounterTimelineViewType.doc: Enumeration of view types for the timeline., View types control layout parameters for the timeline such as maximum track durations and event counts, and optimize event processing for expected display behaviors.

fields.Name: None
fields.doc: Configures the view for an empty timeline display. This mode is recommended for user addons that take full control of the timeline display.

fields.Name: Timeline
fields.doc: Configures the view for a linear timeline display.

fields.Name: Bars
fields.doc: Configures the view for a sorted timer bar display.

fields.Name: FontSize
fields.doc: Scale animations apply to the height of the font. This will cause small jumps between different font heights as the animation progresses, and may adjust the layout of text if used on a fixed-size font string.

fields.Name: Vertex
fields.doc: Scale animations apply to the vertices of the font. Scaling is smoother, but if used on non-slug fonts may cause significant pixelation of the font text, Layout of the text is not adjusted as the animation progresses, and the direction of scaling respects horizontal and vertical justification settings (eg. text at the bottom-right scaling up grows toward the top-left).

fields.Name: SetToDefaults
fields.doc: Restricts resetting this object to a default state. Implied automatically when any other forbidden aspect is set.

fields.Name: ScriptBindings
fields.doc: Restricts querying, replacement, or hooks of scripts on this object.

fields.Name: UntrustedScriptExecution
fields.doc: Restricts execution of all scripts for this object. Propagates to any children of this object.

fields.Name: UntrustedLayoutScriptExecution
fields.doc: Restricts execution of layout scripts (eg. OnSizeChanged) for this object. Propagates to any children of this object, and anything anchored to to this object.

fields.Name: EventRegistrations
fields.doc: Restricts querying or modifying registered script events for this object.

fields.Name: AlwaysPropagateInput
fields.doc: Forces propagation of mouse and keypress input for this object. Propagates to any children.

fields.Name: ScriptedInput
fields.doc: Restricts APIs that trigger synthetic input interactions on objects from Lua scripts.

fields.Name: QueryFocus
fields.doc: Restricts APIs that query input focus state.

fields.Name: ChangeAnimationTarget
fields.doc: Restricts APIs that can change the target object of an animation.

fields.Name: RemoveSecretAspects
fields.doc: Restricts APIs that clear secret aspects from objects.

fields.Name: ChangeParent
fields.doc: Restricts APIs that change the parent of an object.

fields.Name: SetTexture
fields.doc: Restricts APIs that set the texture on a texture object.

fields.Name: QueryRotation
fields.doc: Restricts APIs that query texture rotation.

fields.Name: QueryAnimationProgress
fields.doc: Restricts APIs that query the progress or state of animations.

fields.Name: AddAnimations
fields.doc: Restricts APIs that add animations to animation groups.

fields.Name: None
fields.doc: Not in a house or plot, or at one without even sufficient visiting permissions

fields.Name: Owner
fields.doc: Owner of the current house or plot

fields.Name: Visitor
fields.doc: A visitor of the current house or plot

HousingFixtureDecorAction.doc: Kinds of actions that can be taken to deal with decor attached to an Exterior Fixture that is being removed or swapped

fields.Name: Store
fields.doc: Return any currently-attached decor back into storage

fields.Name: Detach
fields.doc: Detach any currently-attached decor, and leave it floating in its current position; It will NOT be re-attached to the new Exterior Fixtures

fields.Name: Canonicalize
fields.doc: Canonicalizes the locale identifier into ICU's canonical locale ID form.

fields.Name: AddLikelySubtags
fields.doc: Adds likely script and region subtags according to CLDR likely-subtags data.

fields.Name: RemoveLikelySubtags
fields.doc: Minimizes script and region subtags according to CLDR likely-subtags data.

fields.Name: Language
fields.doc: Gets the language code from the locale identifier.

fields.Name: Script
fields.doc: Gets the script code from the locale identifier.

fields.Name: Region
fields.doc: Gets the region code from the locale identifier.

fields.Name: Variant
fields.doc: Gets the variant code from the locale identifier.

fields.Name: ParentLocale
fields.doc: Gets the parent locale identifier.

fields.Name: Linear
fields.doc: Linearly interpolates between points.

fields.Name: Step
fields.doc: Performs no interpolation between points, instead snapping to values exactly.

fields.Name: Cosine
fields.doc: Interpolates between points with cosine smoothing applied.

fields.Name: Cubic
fields.doc: Interpolates between points with cubic smoothing applied. Requires a minimum of four points be defined; less than this will fall back to Cosine interpolation.

fields.Name: Nfc
fields.doc: Canonical decomposition followed by canonical composition.

fields.Name: Nfd
fields.doc: Canonical decomposition.

fields.Name: Nfkc
fields.doc: Compatibility decomposition followed by canonical composition.

fields.Name: Nfkd
fields.doc: Compatibility decomposition.

fields.Name: Decimal
fields.doc: Use normal decimal number format for the locale.

fields.Name: Integer
fields.doc: Use decimal formatting with zero minimum and maximum fraction digits in this wrapper.

fields.Name: Percent
fields.doc: Use percent number format for the locale.

fields.Name: Currency
fields.doc: Use generic currency format with a currency symbol and non-accounting minus-sign negatives.

fields.Name: Disabled
fields.doc: Disable OnUpdate execution.

fields.Name: RunWhenVisible
fields.doc: Run OnUpdate only while object is visible.

fields.Name: RunWhenVisibleOnce
fields.doc: Run OnUpdate once while object is visible; resets to Disabled before running.

fields.Name: RunOnce
fields.doc: Run OnUpdate once regardless of visibility; resets to Disabled before running.

fields.Name: RunAlways
fields.doc: Run OnUpdate regardless of visibility.

fields.Name: Cardinal
fields.doc: Use plural rules for counted quantities, such as 1 file vs. 2 files.

fields.Name: Ordinal
fields.doc: Use plural rules for ordered values, such as 1st, 2nd, 3rd, and 4th.

fields.Name: DenyTaintedAccessWhenAurasAreSecret
fields.doc: Denies access to this script object from tainted execution while aura information is secret.

fields.Name: Hierarchy
fields.doc: Propagation through script object hierarchy relationships, such as parent-child ownership.

fields.Name: Layout
fields.doc: Propagation through layout dependency relationships, such as frames anchored relative to one another.

fields.Name: Preserve
fields.doc: Do not strip any whitespace from interval unit strings.

fields.Name: Strip
fields.doc: Strip whitespace from interval unit strings. Some locales override this setting (eg. deDE, ruRU).

fields.Name: StripIgnoreLocale
fields.doc: Always strip whitespace from interval unit strings even if the client locale should normally preserve whitespace.

fields.Name: RoundUp
fields.doc: Round fractional seconds up to the next whole second when not displaying milliseconds.

fields.Name: Truncate
fields.doc: Truncate fractional seconds to the current whole second when not displaying milliseconds.

fields.Name: NeverSecret
fields.doc: Will never yield secret values when queried.

fields.Name: AlwaysSecret
fields.doc: Will always yield secret values when queried.

fields.Name: ContextuallySecret
fields.doc: May yield secret values when queried depending upon factors such as addon restriction states, unit disposition, etc.

fields.Name: Standard
fields.doc: Fills the bar regularly, either in a left-to-right or top-to-bottom direction as values increase.

fields.Name: StandardNoRangeFill
fields.doc: Similar to standard, except if the range between the min and max values is zero instead render as-if the bar were 100% full. If the min and max values are both zero, will render as 0% full.

fields.Name: Center
fields.doc: Fills the bar in an outward growing manner from the center.

fields.Name: Reverse
fields.doc: Inverse of Standard, filling right-to-left or bottom-to-top as values increase.

fields.Name: Immediate
fields.doc: Immediately snap to the target value with no interpolation.

fields.Name: ExponentialEaseOut
fields.doc: Interpolate the bar toward the target value with exponential ease-out style decay.

fields.Name: Linear
fields.doc: Render the status bar using the existing linear horizontal or vertical fill behavior.

fields.Name: Radial
fields.doc: Render the status bar by driving the managed texture's radial progress fill percent instead of resizing the texture anchors.

fields.Name: ElapsedTime
fields.doc: Calculate status timer bar values using the elapsed time of a duration.

fields.Name: RemainingTime
fields.doc: Calculate status timer bar values using the remaining time of a duration.

fields.Name: Unsorted
fields.doc: Applies no sorting to auras.

fields.Name: Default
fields.doc: Sorts auras according first by whether or not the aura was applied by the player, else whether or not the player can apply the aura, and finally by aura instance ID.

fields.Name: BigDefensive
fields.doc: Sorts auras according first by whether or not the aura was applied by another player, else by expiration time (longest to shortest), and finally by aura instance ID.

fields.Name: Expiration
fields.doc: Sorts auras according first by whether or not the aura was applied by the player, else whether or not the player can apply the aura, then by expiration time (soonest to longest, followed by permanent auras), and finally by aura instance ID.

fields.Name: ExpirationOnly
fields.doc: Sorts auras according only to expiration time.

fields.Name: Name
fields.doc: Sorts auras according first by whether or not the aura was applied by the player, else whether or not the player can apply the aura, then by spell name, and finally by aura instance ID.

fields.Name: NameOnly
fields.doc: Sorts auras according only their spell name.

fields.Name: MissingHealth
fields.doc: Clamp damage absorb values to the amount of missing health with incoming heals subtracted.

fields.Name: MissingHealthWithoutIncomingHeals
fields.doc: Clamp damage absorb values to the amount of missing health. Incoming heals do not decrease missing health.

fields.Name: MaximumHealth
fields.doc: Clamp damage absorb values to the amount of maximum health.

fields.Name: CurrentHealth
fields.doc: Clamp heal absorb values to the amount of current health.

fields.Name: MaximumHealth
fields.doc: Clamp heal absorb values to the amount of maximum health.

fields.Name: ReducedByIncomingHeals
fields.doc: Reduce heal absorb values by incoming heals, and vice versa, clamping to zero where necessary.

fields.Name: Total
fields.doc: Use heal absorb and incoming heal values as-is without any reductions.

fields.Name: MissingHealth
fields.doc: Clamp incoming heal values to the amount of missing health with overflow applied.

fields.Name: MaximumHealth
fields.doc: Clamp incoming heal values to the amount of maximum health.

fields.Name: Default
fields.doc: Use maximum unit health as-is without adjustments.

fields.Name: WithAbsorbs
fields.doc: Use maximum unit health with total damage absorb shields added.

ENCOUNTER_TIMELINE_EVENT_BLOCK_STATE_CHA.doc: Fired when an event has transitioned into or out of a 'blocked' status.

ENCOUNTER_TIMELINE_EVENT_COLOR_CHANGED.doc: Fired when an event has met a condition that should trigger a color change.

ENCOUNTER_TIMELINE_EVENT_STATE_CHANGED.doc: Fired when an event has changed state.

ENCOUNTER_TIMELINE_EVENT_TRACK_CHANGED.doc: Fired when an event has changed track, or has been re-ordered within its existing track.

MythicPlusAffixScoreInfo.doc: Information about a specific M+ run

MythicPlusRatingMapSummary.doc: Specific information about a completed mythic plus run.

MythicPlusRatingSummary.doc: The current season rating and well as a list of completed mythic plus runs.

fields.Name: breakpointData
fields.doc: Order these from largest to smallest.

fields.Name: locale
fields.doc: Locale controls whether standard asian abbreviation data will be used along with a small change in behavior for large number abbreviation when fractionDivisor is greater than zero.

fields.Name: config
fields.doc: Provides a cached config object for optimal performance when calling abbreviation functions multiple times with the same options.

fields.Name: breakpoint
fields.doc: Breakpoints should generally be specified as pairs, with one at the named order (1,000) with fractionDivisor = 10, and one a single order higher (eg. 10,000) with fractionDivisor = 1., This ruleset means numbers like '1234' will be abbreviated to '1.2k' and numbers like '12345' to '12k'.

fields.Name: abbreviation
fields.doc: Abbreviation name to be looked up as a global string.

fields.Name: significandDivisor
fields.doc: significandDivisor and fractionDivisor should multiply such that they become equal to a named order of magnitude, such as thousands or  millions.

fields.Name: abbreviationIsGlobal
fields.doc: Defaults to true. Set to false to skip the global string lookup and use the raw abbreviation string when formatting results

fields.Name: threshold
fields.doc: Minimum input value that this rule applies to.

fields.Name: step
fields.doc: If specified, the input value is rounded to multiples of this step before processing.

fields.Name: rounding
fields.doc: If specified, the rounding mode to apply to the step.

fields.Name: min
fields.doc: If specified, clamps the input value to this value if lesser after rounding.

fields.Name: max
fields.doc: If specified, clamps the input value to this value if greater after rounding.

fields.Name: format
fields.doc: The format string to apply at this threshold. If no components are specified, this can include at-most one numeric format specifier - else, should contain an equal number of format specifiers to elements in the components array.

fields.Name: components
fields.doc: Vector of component descriptions for this rule.

fields.Name: div
fields.doc: If specified, divide the value by this amount and use the resulting quotient. This is applied before modulo division.

fields.Name: mod
fields.doc: If specified, divide the value by this amount and use the resulting remainder. This is applied after quotient division.

fields.Name: step
fields.doc: If specified, round the value to multiples of this step. This is applied after all division.

fields.Name: rounding
fields.doc: If specified, rounding mode to apply to the step.

fields.Name: maxTraversalDepth
fields.doc: Maximum table nesting depth allowed during recursive copying.

fields.Name: wrapUntrustedFunctions
fields.doc: Wrap function values in secure closures that call through using the original function taint.

fields.Name: permitScriptObjects
fields.doc: If true, preserve references to script objects in the copied output. By default, script objects will raise an error.

fields.Name: wrapUntrustedFunctions
fields.doc: Wrap function arguments in secure closures that call through using the original function taint.

fields.Name: chatType
fields.doc: Chat type string ('SAY', 'EMOTE', etc.). Defaults to 'SAY' if not specified.

fields.Name: languageID
fields.doc: Language to send the message in.

fields.Name: target
fields.doc: Name of the player to send a message to. Only applies to chat types that support targeted messages.

fields.Name: actionID
fields.doc: Represents a base spellID for spells, flyoutID for flyouts, or petActionID for pet actions

fields.Name: spellID
fields.doc: May be nil if item is not a spell; Will be the overriding spellID if spell is overriden, otherwise will match actionID

fields.Name: subName
fields.doc: May be empty if flyout, or if spell's data isn't loaded yet; Listen for SPELL_TEXT_UPDATE event, or use SpellMixin to load asynchronously

fields.Name: isPassive
fields.doc: True if the item is a passive spell; Will always be false if it is not a spell

fields.Name: isOffSpec
fields.doc: True if the item belongs to a non-active specialization

fields.Name: skillLineIndex
fields.doc: Index of the SkillLine this SpellBookItem is part of; Nil this SpellBookItem isn't part of a SkillLine

fields.Name: itemIndexOffset
fields.doc: This value + 1 is the first Spell Book Item slotIndex within this skill line

fields.Name: specID
fields.doc: Will be nil if this skill line is not associated with a specialization

fields.Name: offSpecID
fields.doc: Will be nil if this skill line is not associated with a non-active specialization

fields.Name: currentCharges
fields.doc: Number of charges currently available

fields.Name: maxCharges
fields.doc: Max number of charges that can be accumulated

fields.Name: cooldownStartTime
fields.doc: If charge cooldown is active, time at which the most recent charge cooldown began; 0 if cooldown is not active

fields.Name: cooldownDuration
fields.doc: Cooldown duration in seconds required to generate a charge

fields.Name: chargeModRate
fields.doc: Rate at which cooldown UI should update

fields.Name: isActive
fields.doc: False if recharging is not active (ex: at maximum available charges, start time or duration are zero); True otherwise

fields.Name: startTime
fields.doc: If cooldown is active, time started; 0 if no cooldown; Current time if isEnabled is false

fields.Name: duration
fields.doc: Cooldown duration in seconds if active; 0 if cooldown is inactive

fields.Name: isEnabled
fields.doc: False if cooldown is on hold (ex: some cooldowns only start after an active spell is cancelled); True otherwise

fields.Name: isActive
fields.doc: False if cooldown is not active (ex: not enabled, or startTime or duration are 0); True otherwise

fields.Name: modRate
fields.doc: Rate at which cooldown UI should update

fields.Name: activeCategory
fields.doc: Indicates which category is responsible for determining the duration. A nil value indicates the duration was determined through some other logic, e.g. the spell is on hold.

fields.Name: timeUntilEndOfStartRecovery
fields.doc: When this is set it indicates that the spell is in recovery and this is how long it will be until that recovery period is finished

fields.Name: isOnGCD
fields.doc: Whether or not this spell is considered to be on the global cooldown, do not trust this field unless responding to a SPELL_UPDATE_COOLDOWN event

fields.Name: iconID
fields.doc: Icon for this spell; If spell has been overriden, this may be the icon for the overriding spell; See originalIconID for spell's non-overriden icon

fields.Name: startTime
fields.doc: If cooldown is active, time started; 0 if no cooldown

fields.Name: duration
fields.doc: Cooldown duration in seconds if active; 0 if cooldown is inactive

fields.Name: modRate
fields.doc: Rate at which cooldown UI should update

fields.Name: isActive
fields.doc: False if cooldown is not active (startTime or duration are 0); True otherwise

fields.Name: shouldReplaceNormalCooldown
fields.doc: True if this cooldown should be displayed in-place of the normal action cooldown (ex: the LoC cooldown expires later than the normal cooldown); False otherwise

fields.Name: name
fields.doc: The name or 'power token' for this power type (ex: MANA, FOCUS, etc)

fields.Name: cost
fields.doc: Full cost including optional cost; Optional cost is cost the spell will use but isn't required (ex: Rogue spell might cost 1CP but have optional cost of up to 5 more)

fields.Name: minCost
fields.doc: Cost excluding optional cost; This is min required to cast the spell

fields.Name: costPercent
fields.doc: Cost as a percentage of base maximum resource; May be 0 if the cost is simply a flat cost

fields.Name: costPerSec
fields.doc: Cost as a percentage of base maximum resource consumed per second, used by channel spells; May be 0 if cost is simply a flat cost

fields.Name: requiredAuraID
fields.doc: An aura the caster must have for the cost to apply; Usually based on things like active spec or shapeshift form

fields.Name: hasRequiredAura
fields.doc: True if there is a requiredAuraID and the caster currently has that aura; Caster is either the current player or their pet, depending on spell type

fields.Name: maintainColor
fields.doc: If true, preserve all '|c' and '|r' quoted code sequences.

fields.Name: maintainBrackets
fields.doc: If true, preserve all '[' and ']' characters.

fields.Name: stripNewlines
fields.doc: If true, remove all '|n' quoted code sequences.

fields.Name: maintainAtlases
fields.doc: If true, preserve all balanced '|A' and '|a' quoted code sequences.

fields.Name: maintainTextures
fields.doc: If true, preserve all balanced '|T' and '|t' quoted code sequences.

TimedSignalMapCallback.doc: Invoked by a timed signal map when a scheduled time has arrived.

TimedSignalMapEntry.doc: Structure associating a key with a scheduled time.

fields.Name: key
fields.doc: The key that has been scheduled.

fields.Name: time
fields.doc: Absolute time, on the same clock as GetTime(), at which the key is scheduled to signal.

fields.Name: isMet
fields.doc: True if the source for the condition has been fulfilled.

fields.Name: isSufficient
fields.doc: True if meeting the requirements for the condition means any nodes using this condition are considered fulfilled if the condition is met.

fields.Name: type
fields.doc: The value from the TraitConditionType enum the condition uses.

fields.Name: definitionID
fields.doc: Nil on SubTreeSelection Node Entries

fields.Name: subTreeID
fields.doc: Populated only on SubTreeSelection Node Entries; This is the SubTree that is activated if this Entry is chosen

fields.Name: isDisplayError
fields.doc: True if this entry fails the TRAIT_CONDITION_TYPE_DISPLAY_ERROR condition check. Used to communicate a problem with the node to the player (e.g. A prerequisite node has not been purchased.) but will not prevent the player from spending points on the node.

fields.Name: isDisplayError
fields.doc: True if this node fails the TRAIT_CONDITION_TYPE_DISPLAY_ERROR condition check. Used to communicate a problem with the node to the player (e.g. A prerequisite node has not been purchased.) but will not prevent the player from spending points on the node.

fields.Name: entryIDToRanksIncreased
fields.doc: A map of the entry IDs on this node to the number of ranks increased. This covers all entries on the node, which is important in the case of selection nodes where we have more than one option that could be increased.

fields.Name: subTreeID
fields.doc: The SubTree this Node belongs to; Nil if it is not part of a SubTree

fields.Name: subTreeActive
fields.doc: True if this node has a SubTreeID, and the SubTree is chosen or staged; May be nil if not part of a SubTree at all

fields.Name: subTreeSelectionNodeIDs
fields.doc: SubTreeSelectionNodes whose choice entries include this SubTree

fields.Name: posX
fields.doc: Center X node position calculated from the posX values of all of this subTree's nodes

fields.Name: posY
fields.doc: Topmost Y node position taken from the posY values of all of this subTree's nodes

fields.Name: alwaysShowItem
fields.doc: For internal testing only

fields.Name: soundFileName
fields.doc: Sound file to play. Playback stops after five seconds.

fields.Name: soundFileID
fields.doc: Sound file to play. Playback stops after five seconds.

fields.Name: throttleSeconds
fields.doc: Minimum time in seconds between plays. Must be between 0 and 5 seconds, inclusive. Invalid values reject registration.

fields.Name: amount
fields.doc: Amount of applied damage absorb affects with potential reductions from clamping included.

fields.Name: clamped
fields.doc: If true, the value is in excess of the clamp boundary.

fields.Name: amount
fields.doc: Amount of applied heal absorb affects with potential reductions from incoming heals and clamping included.

fields.Name: clamped
fields.doc: If true, the value is in excess of the clamp boundary.

fields.Name: amount
fields.doc: Amount of incoming heals across all units with potential reductions from heal absorb effects included.

fields.Name: amountFromHealer
fields.doc: Amount of incoming heals from the healer unit. Will never exceed the all-units value.

fields.Name: amountFromOthers
fields.doc: Amount of incoming heals from units other than theh healer. Calculated as the difference between amount and amount-from-healer.

fields.Name: clamped
fields.doc: If true, the value is in excess of the clamp boundary.
